title: Why Most Traders Fail The ORB Trading Strategy (And How To Fix It)
description:
Are you consistently losing money with Opening Range Breakout (ORB) strategies? You aren't alone. Thousands of traders attempt this classic setup every single day, yet most fail because they are falling for institutional liquidity traps.

✅ Ready to have success as a trader? Join Raghee on Wednesday August 5th at 7 PM ET to learn how to use volume in your trading and start trading with the volume rather than against it https://bit.ly/4hK1Pj3


✅Contact us here: (512) 266-8659

In this video, I break down the three most common mistakes ORB traders make and the exact fixes required to transform your results. After over 35 years of trading the market open, I have identified why the "break and chase" approach often leads to false breakouts and how you can shift your execution to favor probability over speculation.

We cover:

- The "Breach and Retreat" Method: Why you should stop entering on the break and start waiting for a retest.
- Context is King: How to use the overall trend and key sentiment levels like the Previous Session Close (PSC) to avoid fighting the bigger picture.
- Choosing the Right Clock: Why marking the incorrect time window for your instrument is sabotaging your trades and how to identify institutional fair value correctly.

Don't let the volatility of the market open catch you off guard. Learn to read the rhythm of the institutional order flow and stop treating the open as a dangerous wild zone.
